chosen_tools.name: exa_search
chosen_tools.rationale: Schema/README explicitly call out Exa neural web search for semantic discovery and freshness checks of layoff announcements. Descriptor is locked, fresh (1 day old), and advertises multi-rail accepts that match both configured wallets (base + solana-mainnet, USDC primary). Primary rail (base USDC) aligns with the agent's existing dispatch path, minimizing rail-routing dispatch risk.

chosen_tools.name: twitter_search
chosen_tools.rationale: README designates X/Twitter as the channel for official CEO/company announcements — directly populates official_statement_url, status, and social_signal fields. Same price, same multi-rail accept set as exa_search, fresh descriptor (1 day old), matching wallets on both base and solana-mainnet.

notes: Both chosen tools are locked, resolvable via mcp__pay__list_tools, and reachable on rails (base, solana-mainnet) for which agent wallets are configured (agentwallet:my-agentwallet on 0xBd9E... and AyyQz8...). The other three manifest entries — serper_news, reddit_search, firecrawl_scrape — are unlocked, and the catalog lists their settlement on the `tempo` network (MPP rail) for which no wallet is configured; resolving them would require add_tool or a first-time pay_tool call, both prohibited for this service. They are therefore deliberately excluded for this run. Recommend the searcher prefer rail `base + USDC` (matches current pay dispatch defaults) with `solana-mainnet + USDC` as a documented fallback for both chosen tools.
